purpose: Teach: 恐るべき/逆行/あの世/極意/陳腐/囚われ/円満/時代遅れ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、恐るべき集中力で勉強してたな
lines.en: Riku, you were studying with incredible focus.
lines.style: Light, affectionate observation. Warm undertone beneath the teasing. Quick delivery, eyes bright with admiration barely covered by casual tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、流行に逆行する服装好きだな、桜
lines.en: You've got a thing for clothes that go against the grain, don't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Dry half-smile in the voice. Gentle callout, not mean. Leans back slightly — confident but not cocky. The tone of someone who actually notices what she wears.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、あの世とこの世の話してたな
lines.en: Riku, you were going on about the afterlife and all that.
lines.style: Playful skepticism. Quick, knowing delivery — catching him in something sincere and pretending not to care. Slight smirk audible in the rhythm.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ゲームの極意教えてくれよ、桜
lines.en: Come on, teach me the secret to your game, Sakura.
lines.style: Genuine curiosity underneath cool distance. Slight hesitation before 'teach me' — vulnerability bleeding through. Softer than his usual deflection.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の感想、陳腐すぎだぞ
lines.en: Riku, your take on things is way too clichéd.
lines.style: Sharp, quick jab delivered with fondness. Not cruel. The rhythm of someone who knows exactly which button to push and is doing it affectionately.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、過去のミスに囚われてるな、桜
lines.en: You're still hung up on past mistakes, aren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Quiet observation, almost careful. Not accusatory — genuinely noticing something she carries. Slower pace. The voice of someone who sees her.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前ん家、円満で羨ましいな
lines.en: Riku, I'm actually kind of jealous of how solid your family is.
lines.style: Softer armor dropping for a moment. Honest admission wrapped in casual phrasing. Slight vulnerability in the opening. Warm and a little exposed.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、時代遅れの携帯使ってたな、桜
lines.en: You're still using that ancient phone, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry amusement. Quick, pointed observation. Smirk in the voice without meanness — the intimacy of someone who can tease because they care.
